items.t: The pocket's streets: Chelsea Court, Chelsea Place and Chelsea Close, around Chairlift Road, Skilift Place and Bramwell Road; the District has a pump house at 2600 Chelsea Court. Nearby areas: the British Properties (north), Whitby Estates and Chartwell (north-east), Dundarave (south-west, below) and Altamont (west).

Where the condo stock concentrates: nowhere — Chelsea Park has no verified condo or townhouse stock. The pocket is single-family homes in the RS zones of Zoning Bylaw No. 4662, 2010. The District's verified apartment condos sit in Ambleside and Dundarave, below and west of the pocket.

Transit anchors: TransLink route 256 (Whitby Estates / Park Royal), a community shuttle operated as West Vancouver Blue Bus, runs via Skilift Road, Folkestone Way and Chippendale Road at the west edge of the area; route 251 (Queens / Park Royal) runs on Queens Avenue below the area. The area's exchange is Park Royal, which connects via Marine Drive and Taylor Way to Highway 1 and the Lions Gate Bridge.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Chelsea Park

items.t: District zoning and plans: Chelsea Park sits in the District of West Vancouver under Zoning Bylaw No. 4662, 2010 and Official Community Plan Bylaw No. 4985, 2018. Houses sit in the RS single-family zones — including RS2, RS3, RS5 and RS7 — with Section 200 minimum site areas of 8,094 m² (RS1), 1,625 m² (RS2), 975 m² (RS3), 731 m² (RS4) and 488 m² (RS5); the bylaw's ground-oriented dwelling rules state 4 dwellings maximum per lot, and 6 maximum if the site is wholly or partly within 400 metres of a prescribed bus stop. There is no Chelsea Park-specific local area plan.

Hazard permit areas: District-wide, an Environmental Development Permit is required for work within 15 metres of the top of any watercourse bank, and a Wildfire Hazard Development Permit for work within the Wildfire Hazard Development Permit Area, described as within 100 metres of an undisturbed forest interface — both are live checks on the pocket's upper and ravine-edge lots.

blocks.text: Good to know about Chelsea Park

items.t: Two Vancouver buildings wear this area's name. "Chelsea Court" (788 E 8th Avenue) is a Mount Pleasant strata and "Chelsea by Cressey" (Cambie at West 31st) is a Cambie Corridor project — both surface in "Chelsea" condo searches, and neither is within several municipalities of the West Vancouver pocket. Check the municipality on every result before treating it as comparable.
The school locator has a hole exactly where the pocket is.

The pocket sits on Guinness land. The District's history page states a British group led by the Guinness family purchased most of the Upper Lands and began to build the British Properties, and built the Lions Gate Bridge as the first fixed crossing to Vancouver — Chelsea Park is at the south edge of those lands, which is why its lots and street pattern read as estate subdivision rather than village infill.

The "park" in Chelsea Park is a dedicated RS7 park site. Chairlift Park is listed in the District Parks Master Plan as RS7 and Dedicated — the parkland is dedicated, which is a stronger protection than an ordinary park zoning, and it anchors the Chelsea Close end of the pocket.
No Chelsea Park-specific plan exists. The District-wide OCP (Bylaw No. 4985, 2018) is the only plan covering the pocket.

The District's own pump house is the pocket's civic footprint. A District water report lists a pump house at 2600 Chelsea Court, and District water is metered and billed quarterly — the street's infrastructure is municipal, but the address itself fell outside the school locator's ranges, a small example of how thin the official paper trail is for this pocket.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Chelsea Park
Streets, schools and getting around Chelsea Park

items.t: Where the townhouse stock concentrates: nowhere — Chelsea Park has no verified townhouse stock. The pocket is single-family homes in the RS single-family zones of Zoning Bylaw No. 4662, 2010. The District's verified townhouse pockets are elsewhere (Whitby Estates and Caulfeild, per the District-wide townhomes assembly), and its apartment condos sit in Ambleside and Dundarave, below and west of the pocket.

Schools: no SD45 school physically inside Chelsea Park is confirmed. SD45 describes Westcot Elementary (K–7) as situated at the foot of the British Properties, and Irwin Park Elementary (K–7), 2455 Haywood Avenue, as situated in Dundarave, south-west of the area. SD45 has no middle tier (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12).

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Chelsea Park

items.t: Form B diligence (strata purchases elsewhere in the District): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page.

Fee-simple homes (the stock that does exist here): Chelsea Park is in the District of West Vancouver — White Rock's Bylaw 2506 / 2220 pair belongs to White Rock only and is never attributed here, and the Vancouver Empty Homes Tax does not apply.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Chelsea Park
Fee-simple lots

items.t: RS street fabric: single-family homes on Chelsea Court, Chelsea Place, Chelsea Close, Chairlift Road and Skilift Place in the RS single-family zones of Zoning Bylaw No. 4662, 2010 — RS2, RS3, RS5 and RS7 all appear in District material for this area (the Parks Master Plan lists Chairlift Park in this area as RS7). Current listings confirm the tenure on the ground: a listing for 2662 Chelsea Place records Ownership Type Freehold NonStrata, and a listing for 2790 Chelsea Close records Building Type Single Family Residence and Ownership Type Freehold NonStrata. A fee-simple lot carries no strata, no Form B and no strata fees.

Lot character from Section 200, as stated: minimum site areas of 8,094 m² in RS1, 1,625 m² in RS2, 975 m² in RS3, 731 m² in RS4 and 488 m² in RS5, with RS6 using the area of the site of record in the District-wide section. The RS range that can apply here runs the full ladder, so subdivision and suite potential differ lot by lot — the zone and minimum for a specific lot are confirmed on the District's Zoning Map. These are zone minimums, not a claim about any existing lot's size.

Suites as lot value: District building-permit guidance addresses secondary suite and detached secondary suite (coach house) applications in these RS areas — a suite or coach house sits on the house lot's title and is part of its ownership, never a separately saleable lot.

Serviced position, as the District states it: West Vancouver water and sewer utilities are metered and billed quarterly by the District, and the District's water report lists a pump house at 2600 Chelsea Court, confirming District water service on the street.

blocks.text: Not in this Chelsea Park

items.t: Chelsea Court — 788 E 8th Avenue, Vancouver

Chelsea by Cressey — Cambie Street at West 31st Avenue, Vancouver: A Cressey project (65 condos plus nine townhomes, completed 2021 per the presale record) in Vancouver's Cambie Corridor — again, a name match only, in a different municipality.

Chairlift Park is a park, not housing: the "Park" in the pocket's name-in-use is a District park site on the Chelsea Close streets, listed as RS7 and Dedicated — it is not a housing complex of any form and never lot stock.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Chelsea Park

items.t: Municipality: District of West Vancouver, BC — Chelsea Park is a small residential pocket at the south edge of the British Properties area, above Wentworth Avenue and Queens Avenue and south of Highway 1.

What District sources show is the street cluster itself: Chelsea Court, Chelsea Place and Chelsea Close around Chairlift Road, Skilift Place and Bramwell Road, and a District pump house at 2600 Chelsea Court.

Roads and transit: Chairlift Road, Skilift Place, Chelsea Court, Chelsea Place and Chelsea Close serve the pocket. TransLink route 256 (Whitby Estates / Park Royal), a community shuttle operated as West Vancouver Blue Bus, runs via Skilift Road at the west edge of the area to Park Royal; route 251 (Queens / Park Royal) runs below the area on Queens Avenue. The area's exchange is Park Royal.

Parks and services: Chairlift Park, on the Chelsea Close streets, is listed in the District Parks Master Plan as RS7 and Dedicated. Park Royal, below the area at Marine Drive and Taylor Way, is recognized in the District's OCP as the regional shopping centre. The West Vancouver Community Centre and Aquatic Centre, 2121 Marine Drive in Ambleside, and West Vancouver Memorial Library, 1950 Marine Drive, serve the pocket. Lions Gate Hospital, 231 East 15th Street, North Vancouver, serves the North Shore.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Chelsea Park

items.t: Ground-oriented density / SSMUH, as the bylaw states it: 4 dwellings maximum per lot, and 6 maximum if the site is wholly or partly within 400 metres of a prescribed bus stop (Bylaw 4662, ss.620–630). Verify the current infill zoning per property before marketing multiplex potential.

Strata block: Form B diligence (fees, amounts owed, levies, CRF balance, insurance summary; within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page); depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws void since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid under SPA ss.123.1/123.2, with May 1, 2023 exemptions. A listing's "45+" line is not a valid BC age bylaw.

ALR rules (no Chelsea Park ALR parcel is confirmed here; standing rules for completeness only): ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)); subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; residence caps principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha); farm class three-tier ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an error.

blocks.text: Good to know about Chelsea Park

items.t: The District does not use this name: "Chelsea Park" appears in no District neighbourhood or planning document read — the operative documents are the District-wide OCP 4985 and Zoning Bylaw 4662, read lot by lot, and comparable sales for these streets may sit under British Properties or Chartwell labels. A buyer searching District documents for "Chelsea Park" zoning will find nothing.

The school locator has a hole on this street: Chelsea Court's listed locator ranges start at 2620 (even) and 2611 (odd), so a low-numbered Chelsea Court address returns no result at all rather than a wrong school — a "no catchment found" answer here is a data gap, not evidence a lot is unserved.

The pocket sits on Guinness ground: the District's history records that a British group led by the Guinness family purchased most of the Upper Lands, began the British Properties, and built the Lions Gate Bridge as the first fixed crossing to Vancouver — this pocket is the south edge of that original estate fabric, below the large-estate streets.

Its one named place is a park with a zoning label: Chairlift Park is listed in the District Parks Master Plan as "RS7 and Dedicated" — the park carries a residential zone label in the District's own plan, which is a reminder to read the Zoning Map, not the park name, for what a neighbouring lot can do.

Transit is a shuttle, not a corridor: the pocket's own service is the 256 community shuttle via Skilift Road to Park Royal, with the 251 on Queens Avenue below — most households here drive for daily trips, and lot value should not be priced off a frequent-transit assumption without checking the 400 m bus-stop rule lot by lot.

No market figure exists to quote for this pocket: West Vancouver is outside SnapStats coverage entirely, so any Chelsea Park median, ratio or trend figure attributed to SnapStats anywhere should be treated as an error.
